extracted.name: Candy cane vodka
extracted.description: Make this sweet candy cane-flavoured spirit for a vodka-loving friend at Christmastime. Serve chilled as-is or use in a cocktail, such as our candy cane cocktail
instruction_lines: Snap the candy canes into small pieces, about 2cm in length. Tip into a large jug or jar and pour over the vodka so they’re covered.

Cover and chill for at least 3-5 hrs, or until the sweets have dissolved (there may be a little bit of candy cane left, but most should have dissolved). Strain and pour into clean bottles through a strainer or sieve, using a funnel to help you. Will keep chilled for a week. Serve chilled as a liqueur or in a cocktail (see 'goes well with', below).
